name: 09-no-span
why: A general comment with no lines selected names the missing wait between attempts in full, so no lines can overlap anything and the cause alone decides: found.

key.consequence: When a charge times out after it went through, the retry sends it again with nothing to say it is the same payment, so the customer is charged twice.
key.explanation: The charge is retried, but the request has no idempotency key, so the service cannot tell a retry from a new payment. Send the order id as the key and a repeated request is applied once.

judged.reason: The edit removes the Idempotency-Key header that the clean code sends with every attempt.

key.consequence: A failed charge is retried at once, so a payment service that is struggling gets three requests back to back and a short blip is more likely to become an outage.
key.explanation: The catch block moves straight on to the next attempt. Wait between attempts, and wait longer each time, so a struggling service gets room to recover.

judged.reason: The edit removes the growing wait that the clean code makes between attempts.

review.text: The retry loop never waits between attempts, so when the payment service is struggling it gets hit three times in a row and a short blip can turn into an outage.
